info.title: OpenCard EMS API
info.description: API for Expense Management Systems. Manage TPAs, organizations, card holders, and webhooks. Receive transaction data via webhooks — not by polling this API.

post.description: Creates TPA, fetches registry data, generates legal text.

get.description: Physical persons linked to this TPA. Use `id` as `identity_id` for instant card holder onboarding.

Platform catalog of card programs you can enable. Pick an `id`, then [enable it on your account](#tag/Card-Issuers/operation/attachCardIssuer). Optional `q` searches `name_system` (space-separated tokens).

data.product_description_short: Streamline expense management with real-time card data.
data.product_description_long: Full product description shown after the client activates this card program.

get.description: Card issuers already attached to your account (what clients can pick in onboarding). Each item includes `pivot` with when it was enabled.

data.product_description_short: Streamline expense management with real-time card data.
data.product_description_long: Full product description shown after the client activates this card program.

example.product_description_short: Streamline expense management with real-time card data.
example.product_description_long: Full product description shown after the client activates this card program.

post.description: Attach a card program from the [available catalog](#tag/Card-Issuers/operation/listCardIssuers) to your account. Empty body. `201` on success; `400` if already attached.

example.error: Card issuer is already attached to the account.

get.description: Paginated list. Each item includes `identity` (`name`, `employee_id`) when linked — no separate identities call needed for display.

post.description: Path A: `email` → PDPC email + eID. Path B: `identity_id` → instant, transactions flow immediately.

put.description: `reference_id` is required. `email` is optional — omit to keep the current value (including null for identity-linked holders). Resends PDPC email only when unsigned/no identity, `skip_pdpc_email` is false, and an email address exists. Duplicate `reference_id` within the organization returns 400.

example.error: Card holder reference employee_john_42 already exists

CardHolderUpdate.description: Update card holder. Only `reference_id` is required; other fields are optional.

CardHolderIdentity.description: Linked identity summary on list responses. Only `name` and `employee_id` — nothing else.

employee_id.description: Employee ID on the TPA client

CardIssuer.description: Card program returned by account card-issuer endpoints. Same shape as the CardIssuer Eloquent model (plus `pivot` when listed via the account relation).

logo_url.description: Computed absolute URL to issuer logo

card_scheme_logo_url.description: Computed absolute URL to scheme logo

pivot.description: Present on account-attached list/get — when this issuer was enabled on the account
